column3: Close to the Hebrew; NKJV adds “A Psalm” to the title.
Close to the Hebrew; “bow down” is rendered “worship,” and “covenant loyalty and faithfulness” “lovingkindness and truth.”
Close to the Hebrew; “you made me bold in my soul with strength” is rendered “made me bold with strength in my soul.”
Close to the Hebrew; יִגְמֹר (“will complete”) is rendered “will perfect,” and “covenant loyalty” “mercy.”
